title: Paul McCartney live: Bell MTS Place, Winnipeg | 2018
content:
Paul McCartney performed at the Bell MTS Place in Winnipeg, Canada, on 28 September 2018.

It was the third show of the Freshen Up Tour, which lasted for 39 dates between September 2018 and July 2019. This concert was seen by 12,610 fans.

McCartney’s band was Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens (vocals, keyboards, guitar, percussion, harmonica), Brian Ray (vocals, guitar, bass), Rusty Anderson (vocals, guitar), Abe Laboriel Jr (vocals, drums), Kenji Fenton (saxophone), Mike Davis (trumpet), and Paul Burton (trombone).
